room_rent.note: No room-rent sub-limit stated in base Inpatient Care; optional 'Reduction in Room Rent' (3.4.11) discounts premium for a cap

icu.note: ICU charges paid under base Inpatient Care; no cap stated

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base; Voluntary Co-payment (3.4.1) optional for premium discount

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise capping found in base benefits

initial_waiting.note: Excl03; not applicable after 12 months continuous cover

ped_waiting.note: Excl01; reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional add-on (3.4.9)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Excl02; reducible to 12 months via optional (3.4.10)

maternity.note: Mother & Child Care (3.4.4), 3-yr policy only, 12/24mo wait, female 18-45

cumulative_bonus.note: VERIFY: no inbuilt cumulative/no-claim bonus found in base; Super Charger SI is an optional add-on (3.4.3.1)

restoration.note: Base Restore (3.1.11) 100% SI once/yr, not for same illness; Unlimited Restore (3.4.2.2) optional

ambulance.note: Emergency + intercity ambulance (3.1.9); air ambulance optional (3.4.3.2)

modern_treatments.note: Robotic, stem cell, immunotherapy etc. under 3.1.2

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18); maternity, consumables, global, super-charger bonus all need add-ons

optional_riders.display: Consumables, Unlimited Restore, Super Charger, Air Ambulance, Maternity/Newborn, OPD, Global, PED/specific waiting reduction, Room Rent reduction
